topic_title: Speed Related to Stopping & Roadway Conditions
prompt: What is the legal minimum tire tread depth required for passenger motor vehicles operating in Texas?

options.text: At least 4/32 inch of tread depth across all major center tire grooves
At least 1/16 inch of tread depth measured on the outer tire sidewall
At least 2/32 inch of tread depth in all major grooves of road contact
Tires may be completely bald provided the inner steel belt is unexposed
